description: For a nightcore (faster and higher) or slowed (slower and lower) version: the pitch change in semitones for a speed, the new BPM if given, and typical settings. Defaults: nightcore 1.25x, slowed 0.80x.

bpm.description: Original tempo, to report the new BPM.

speed.description: Playback speed, e.g. 1.25 for 25% faster or 0.8 for 20% slower.

style.description: Which effect; sets the default speed.
